title.en: Geography: Human Geography of Tamil Nadu

text.en: Raju noticed the busy city of Chennai. "How do people live in different parts of Tamil Nadu?" he asked.

Human geography studies people and their activities. Tamil Nadu has a large population with high urbanisation, and Chennai, Coimbatore and Madurai are big cities. Literacy is high and the sex ratio is better than the national average.
Farming, fishing, industry and services are the main occupations. Transport includes a strong road and rail network, ports at Chennai, Ennore and Thoothukudi and airports at Chennai, Madurai and Coimbatore.
Tamil Nadu is known for its temples, handlooms, festivals and arts. Tourism, IT and education add to the economy, and we should preserve its heritage and the environment.
